description:
# TAPP Composition Module: SolutionIntroduction

The shared **SolutionIntroduction** block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library, composed by **3 of the sixteen** delivery tables — 16 owned fields over 5 schema paths.

Generated by `tools/build_module_bb.py` from `Module_SolutionIntroduction.csv` and its schema-path sidecar. Edit those, not the schema.

This is a **profile, not a vocabulary**: it asserts which properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries, all of them already defined by `tappDefinition` or `adaProduct`.

## The two `$defs`

| `$def` | composed into | properties | required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ProcedureIdentification` | a TAPP schema (`prov:Plan`) | 5 | 4 |

Requiredness follows the TAPP tier matrix: a field Basic on a side is required there, Advanced is permitted, N/A is absent from that side entirely.

## Composing it

```yaml
allOf:
- $ref: ../../../BaseSchema/tappDefinition/schema.yaml
- $ref: ../../../BaseSchema/modules/solutionIntroduction/schema.yaml#/$defs/ProcedureIdentification
- type: object
  properties: {}   # only what this technique itself owns
```

`allOf` composes constraints and cannot relax them: a technique composing this module accepts its required set in full.

$defs:
  ProcedureIdentification:
    title: SolutionIntroduction on the procedure
    description: 'Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema: what the procedure asserts
      once, for every analysis that follows it.'
    type: object
    properties:
      schema:actionProcess:
        type: object
        properties:
          schema:step:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              allOf:
              - if:
                  properties:
                    schema:name:
                      const: Sample digestion
                  required:
                  - schema:name
                then:
                  properties:
                    bios:reagent:
                      type: array
                      items:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          schema:name:
                            description: "Acid mixture used for sample dissolution.
                              Record acid type(s) and concentration(s) where known
                              (e.g., concentrated HF\u2013HNO3 in Parr bombs is standard
                              for silicate dissolution). For isotope-ratio work, complete
                              matrix dissolution is required to avoid isotopic fractionation
                              during partial dissolution."
                            type: string
                            x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/name
                      x-jsonld-id: https://bioschemas.org/reagent
            allOf:
            - contains:
                properties:
                  schema:name:
                    const: Sample digestion
                required:
                - schema:name
            x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/step
        x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/actionProcess
      ada:chromatographicSeparationApplied:
        description: "Whether chromatographic separation of element groups (e.g.,
          using ion exchange resin) was performed prior to analysis. Separation may
          be required to remove matrix elements that cause variable mass bias, to
          eliminate isobaric interferences, or to isolate an element group before
          measurement (e.g., Fe and Cu\u2013Zn for isotope dilution, Hf separation
          from REE, removal of Cr and Ni from Fe fractions). It is usually mandatory
          for isotope-ratio procedures and optional for concentration measurement.
          Record resin type and elution matrix conditions if applied. Record 'None'
          if the direct digestion solution is analyzed."
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/chromatographicSeparationApplied
      ada:isotopeDilutionSpike:
        description: Isotopic spike material added to the sample before or during
          digestion for isotope dilution (ID) analysis or double-spike mass bias correction.
          For double-spike procedures, the spike must be added and equilibrated before
          digestion to correct for any isotopic fractionation during dissolution and
          column chemistry. For concentration ID, the spike must be added before digestion
          for complete equilibration. Record spike name or certificate reference,
          spike isotopes, and whether added pre- or post-digestion. Record 'None'
          if ID or double-spike technique is not used.
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/isotopeDilutionSpike
      ada:finalSolutionMatrix:
        description: Acid type and concentration of the final dissolved sample solution
          introduced to the instrument. Directly affects instrument response and ion
          transmission. For isotope-ratio procedures, acid molarity must be precisely
          matched between samples and bracketing standards to avoid matrix-induced
          mass bias offsets. Procedures targeting HFSE may add trace HF to the final
          solution to keep those elements in solution.
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/finalSolutionMatrix
      ada:washTimeBetweenSamples:
        description: Duration of instrument rinse between successive sample solutions
          (seconds). Controls carryover and memory effects. For isotope-ratio work,
          complete washout is critical to prevent cross-contamination between samples
          with differing isotopic compositions.
        anyOf:
        - type: number
        - type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/washTimeBetweenSamples
    required:
    - ada:chromatographicSeparationApplied
    - ada:finalSolutionMatrix
    - ada:isotopeDilutionSpike
    - ada:washTimeBetweenSamples
